title: A shelf of jam jars
checked: Every reachable state checked (4 states, 12 with their data, 18 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 4 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: Gone off only past its weeks
rules.says: A jar goes off only when it has been open longer than its kind keeps.
rules.path: Take away the past its weeks guard and it breaks in 2 steps: open it, a week later.

rules.says: A jar is eaten up only after its last spoonful.
rules.path: Take away the last spoon guard and it breaks in 2 steps: open it, a spoonful.

rules.says: A jar with its lid on does not count the weeks.
